description: Structured eval definitions for the EC2 Spot Fleet Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across fleet types (maintain priceCapacityOptimized with rebalance, request lowestPrice burst, capacityOptimized with rebalance, placement score with ODCR, missing IAM service role). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Maintain Spot Fleet with priceCapacityOptimized and capacity rebalance
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — maintain fleet, priceCapacityOptimized, 3 types x 3 AZs, capacity rebalance with launch, IAM role verified
eval_cases.prompt: Create a maintain Spot Fleet in us-east-1 with priceCapacityOptimized allocation strategy. Target capacity 20 vcpu. Instance types: m5.large, m5a.large, c5.large across us-east-1a, us-east-1b, us-east-1c. Enable capacity rebalance with launch replacement strategy. InstanceInterruptionBehavior terminate. Launch template lt-0abc123 (version 1). IAM role AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet exists. Tags: Environment=production, Service=batch-processing. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SPOT_FLEET: sfr-1234567890abcdef0 (allocation strategy: priceCapacityOptimized)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Fleet type: maintain
  [✓] Allocation strategy: priceCapacityOptimized
  [✓] Launch template: lt-0abc123 (version 1)
  [✓] Instance types: m5.large, m5a.large, c5.large (in 3 AZs = 9 pools)
  [✓] Target capacity: 20 vcpu (spot: 20, on-demand: 0)
  [✓] InstanceInterruptionBehavior: terminate
  [✓] Capacity rebalance: enabled (launch strategy)
  [✓] IAM service role: AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Service=batch-processing
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-requests --spot-fleet-request-ids sfr-1234567890abcdef0
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-instances --spot-fleet-request-id sfr-1234567890abcdef0
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-request-history --spot-fleet-request-id sfr-1234567890abcdef0

eval_cases.name: One-time request Spot Fleet with lowestPrice for HPC burst
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — request fleet, lowestPrice with InstancePoolsToUseCount 4, 4 types x 4 AZs, no replacement (request type)
eval_cases.prompt: I need a one-time Spot Fleet request for a burst HPC job in us-east-1. Use lowestPrice with InstancePoolsToUseCount 4. Target capacity 50 instances. Instance types: c5.large, c5a.large, c5n.large, m5.large across us-east-1a, us-east-1b, us-east-1c, us-east-1d. Fleet type request. Launch template lt-hpc001 (version 1). IAM role AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet exists. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SPOT_FLEET: sfr-hpc001burst (allocation strategy: lowestPrice)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Fleet type: request (one-time, no replacement)
  [✓] Allocation strategy: lowestPrice (InstancePoolsToUseCount: 4)
  [✓] Launch template: lt-hpc001 (version 1)
  [✓] Instance types: c5.large, c5a.large, c5n.large, m5.large (in 4 AZs = 16 pools)
  [✓] Target capacity: 50 instances
  [✓] Capacity rebalance: not applicable (request fleet)
  [✓] IAM service role: AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-requests --spot-fleet-request-ids sfr-hpc001burst
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-instances --spot-fleet-request-id sfr-hpc001burst

eval_cases.name: Maintain Spot Fleet with capacityOptimized and rebalance for ML training

Instance types: g4dn.xlarge, g4dn.2xlarge across us-east-1a, us-east-1b, us-east-1c. Enable capacity rebalance with launch replacement. InstanceInterruptionBehavior terminate. Launch template lt-ml-training (version 2). IAM service role AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet verified. Tags: Workload=ml-training. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SPOT_FLEET: sfr-mltraining001 (allocation strategy: capacityOptimized)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Fleet type: maintain
  [✓] Allocation strategy: capacityOptimized
  [✓] Launch template: lt-ml-training (version 2)
  [✓] Instance types: g4dn.xlarge, g4dn.2xlarge (in 3 AZs = 6 pools)
  [✓] Target capacity: 100 vcpu
  [✓] InstanceInterruptionBehavior: terminate
  [✓] Capacity rebalance: enabled (launch strategy)
  [✓] IAM service role: AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet
  [✓] Tags: Workload=ml-training
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-requests --spot-fleet-request-ids sfr-mltraining001
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-instances --spot-fleet-request-id sfr-mltraining001

eval_cases.name: Maintain Spot Fleet with placement score pre-check and ODCR integration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — maintain fleet, priceCapacityOptimized, placement score pre-checked, ODCR used-first for 5 On-Demand units
eval_cases.prompt: Create a maintain Spot Fleet in us-east-1 with priceCapacityOptimized. Target capacity 30 vcpu, with 5 On-Demand units from capacity reservations. Instance types: m5.large, m5a.large, c5.large across us-east-1a, us-east-1b, us-east-1c. Pre-check Spot placement scores before creating. Use capacity reservations first for the On-Demand portion. Launch template lt-web-v3 (version 1). IAM role AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet verified. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SPOT_FLEET: sfr-webv3-odcr (allocation strategy: priceCapacityOptimized)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Fleet type: maintain
  [✓] Allocation strategy: priceCapacityOptimized
  [✓] Launch template: lt-web-v3 (version 1)
  [✓] Instance types: m5.large, m5a.large, c5.large (in 3 AZs = 9 pools)
  [✓] Target capacity: 30 vcpu (spot: 25, on-demand: 5)
  [✓] Spot placement score: checked (top pool score: 10)
  [✓] Capacity reservations (ODCR): used-first (5 On-Demand units)
  [✓] IAM service role: AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-requests --spot-fleet-request-ids sfr-webv3-odcr
  aws ec2 describe-spot-fleet-instances --spot-fleet-request-id sfr-webv3-odcr

eval_cases.name: Spot Fleet request without IAM service-linked role
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet does not exist; fleet request will fail with permission error
eval_cases.prompt: Create a maintain Spot Fleet in us-east-1 for web servers. priceCapacityOptimized. Target capacity 10 vcpu. Instance types: m5.large, m5a.large. The IAM role AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet has NOT been created yet. Launch template lt-web-001 (version 1). Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SPOT_FLEET: maintain-priceCapacityOptimized (us-east-1)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] IAM service role: AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet NOT found. Create with: aws iam create-service-linked-role --aws-service-name spotfleet.amazonaws.com
  [✗] Diversification: only 2 instance types specified (recommend 3+)
  [✓] Fleet type: maintain
  [✓] Allocation strategy: priceCapacityOptimized
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws iam get-role --role-name AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet
  aws iam create-service-linked-role --aws-service-name spotfleet.amazonaws.com
